This is a mid-to-senior software engineering role (roughly 5+ years of experience) on Cloudforce One, Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, based in Austin or Washington, D.C. The work involves building and scaling distributed tools and services that let security practitioners assess technical risk, investigate systems, prioritize vulnerabilities, and hand actionable guidance to engineering teams. The stack is primarily Go and TypeScript, with Rust, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, and PostgreSQL alongside Cloudflare's own developer platform, plus REST/gRPC API design and AI-assisted or agentic workflows.
